history.content: Do I need to be a broker to trade on the exchange?

In the US, there is a mandated firewall between the individual and the exchange, the broker; therefore, in the US, one would have to start a business and become a broker. To trade directly on an exchange, you need to register with them. That costs money, and only a limited number of people can register. Technology is supplanting the need for brokers. I don't believe there is any human-broker-free stock exchange, but Nasdaq and other traditional OTC (over-the-counter) exchanges are as close as they get since they never even had trading floors. Based on the information provided, in the US, there is a mandated firewall between the individual and the exchange, which means that individuals cannot trade directly on the exchange without becoming a broker. However, if becoming a broker is too costly, using a broker or trade platform with the lowest commissions is an alternative.

The Nasdaq is a secondary market where stocks are bought and sold. The process of creating new stocks through initial public offerings (IPOs) or private placements is referred to as the private market. It is a stock exchange in the USA owned by the Nasdaq OMX Group, a corporation listed on the Nasdaq under the symbol NDAQ. Nasdaq generates revenue by charging fees for market data services, which are available in the Nasdaq Datastore.

evidence.text: Yes, you often can buy stocks directly from the company at little or no transaction cost.  Many companies have either a Dividend Reinvestment Plan (DRIP) or a Direct Stock Plan (DSP).  With these plans, you purchase shares directly from the company (although, often there is a third party transfer agent that handles the transaction), and the stock is issued in your name.  This differs from purchasing stock from a broker, where the stock normally remains in the name of the broker. Generally, in order to begin participating in a DRIP, you need to already be a registered stockholder. Mutual funds are a collection of other assets, such as stocks, bonds and property. Unless the fund is a type that is traded on an exchange, you will only be able to buy into the fund by applying for units with the fund manager and sell out by contacting the fund manager. These type of non-traded funds are usually updated at the end of the day once the closing prices of all the assets in it are known.

A stock market is just that, a market place where buyers and sellers come together to buy and sell shares in companies listed on that stock market. There is no global stock price, the price relates to the last price a stock was traded at on a particular stock market. However, a company can be listed on more than one stock exchange. For example, some Australian companies are listed both on the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) and the NYSE, and they usually trade at different prices on the different exchanges. Also, there is no formula to determine a stock price. It is all to do with supply and demand and peoples' emotions.
